interface.signature: routes: List[List[int]], S: int, T: int -> int

preconditions.description: Each bus route must contain at least one stop.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= stop < 10**6 for route in routes for stop in route)
preconditions.description: Each bus stop must be a non-negative integer less than 10^6.
Start (S) and destination (T) stops must be non-negative integers less than 10^6.
If S equals T, no buses are needed (implicitly handled by returning 0 or -1).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and return_value <= len(routes))
postconditions.description: The result is either -1 (impossible) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of buses taken, which cannot exceed the total number of buses.

postconditions.expression: S == T and return_value == 0
postconditions.description: If the start and destination stops are the same, the result must be 0 (no buses needed).

postconditions.expression: all(any(stop in route for route in routes) for stop in [S, T])
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, both S and T must be reachable by at least one bus route.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and any(T in route for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, the destination T must be reachable by at least one bus route.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and any(S in route for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If the result is not -1, the start S must be reachable by at least one bus route.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(not (S in route and T in route) or return_value >= 2 for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If S and T are on the same route, the result must be at least 2 (since you cannot take the same bus twice in a row to reach T).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(not (S in route and T in route) or return_value == 1 for route in routes))
postconditions.description: If S and T are on the same route, the result must be 1 (directly reachable).
